summary: Frontend-only UI test for landing-page clickable channel grid tiles and feature cards. All 11 test scenarios from the review request passed: (1) no-nickname state prompts toast + focuses nickname input for both tiles and feature cards, (2) after nickname submit the app lands on the correct target room (section-c/section-a/stranger), (3) nickname-already-set path navigates directly, (4) direct /chat?room=... and /chat?tab=stranger URL params resolve correctly and are cleared after mount, (5) invalid room param falls back to general, (6) regression enter-button flow still lands on general, (7) all 19 grid tiles (GEN + section-a..section-r) and all 3 feature cards have their expected data-testid attributes and are clickable buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx: submit() uses buildChatPath(pendingTarget) after setNickname; because pendingTarget is React state, this is fine but note that stale-closure would break it if submit ever became async — currently safe.

Chat.jsx: resolveInitialRoom accepts 'general' via both explicit check and isPublicRoom fallback; consider unifying by adding GENERAL to ALL_PUBLIC_ROOMS check semantics (currently ALL_PUBLIC_ROOMS already includes GENERAL_ROOM, so the extra check `room === 'general'` is redundant but harmless).
Minor: Feature card data-testid 'feature-card-general' collides conceptually with grid-tile-general but they are distinct testids — OK, just be aware.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth needed; nickname stored in localStorage key 'cs_chatroom_nickname'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend was untouched this iteration; iteration_1.json and iteration_2.json cover backend. Frontend bug-fix for clickable landing tiles/cards is fully verified. All data-testids are stable: grid-tile-general, grid-tile-section-a..r, feature-card-section-rooms, feature-card-general, feature-card-random-stranger, nickname-input, enter-chatroom-btn, stranger-panel, chat-main.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration is a fix verification, not an RCA. Original bug (decorative divs) is fixed by converting tiles/cards to <button type='button'> with onClick={enterChat(target)} where enterChat either navigates immediately (nickname set) or focuses input + shows toast + stores pendingTarget for later submit-time navigation. URL params are consumed via useMemo(resolveInitialRoom) then cleared via setSearchParams({}, {replace:true}) in a mount-only effect.
